values.value: Finds: Product2 records where IsActive=true AND Name contains one of: "Renewal Only", "Legacy", "Deprecated", "Retired", "Obsolete", "Do Not Sell" (case-insensitive). Why it matters: Soft-retirement by naming convention is the most common shadow-governance pattern: the team agrees "this SKU is dead" but no system flag enforces it. New deals can still pick up these products via search/picklist, CSMs apply them to amendments where they fail at pricebook lookup, and product hierarchy reporting double-counts them as live revenue. Flip IsActive=false or formalize a proper retirement workflow with a system-level Status field. Suppress a finding: when the naming is informational only and the product is intentionally still sellable. Disable the detector: only if your business genuinely uses these labels for active products (rare — these strings are nearly always retirement markers).
